paragraphs.text: A self-hosted Loom for DeepSeek Harness: branch AI conversations, compare code changes in Git worktr
ees, and write prose with Weave.
# Loom for DeepSeek Harness
> **Loom has moved to scasella/dsh-loom.** Use that repository for the standalone plugin, current in
stallation instructions, releases, and issue tracking. This fork is preserved as a read-only referen
ce, including its historical releases, source, and existing links. The instructions below describe t
he historical fork release.
English | 中文
Branch an agent task or a passage of prose, compare alternatives, and keep every path you explored.
Loom adds a conversation tree, workspace comparisons, and a prose editor to DeepSeek Harness.
This is an independently maintained community fork of DeepSeek Harness, the open-source, Cordis-powe
red agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI. Both projects use the MIT license.
Source prerelease · Watch the demo · Install and set up · Loom user guide · Report an issue
## Watch the demo
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3a35ceab-bd12-4e20-a4c9-b0bda106d687
3:54, 1080p, with explanatory captions and no audio. The demo uses real model calls and captured UI
states with edited timing. Download the full-quality video or captions.
## What you can do
| Feature | Try it with Loom |
| Branch conversations | Regenerate several answers, steer variants with different instructions, or

edit a prompt into a new branch. Override the children's model and thinking settings. |
| Read the t
ree | Navigate siblings, keep or set aside branches, expand inherited turns, and inspect logged mode

l requests and reasoning. |
| Compare workspace changes | Give competing edits separate Git worktree
s. Compare tests, diffs, own usage, and time; apply a patch, adopt a branch, or discard its worktree

. |
| Try hypothetical tool results | Edit a recorded result in a fork and let the model continue fr

om that observation without rerunning the tool. |
| Write with Weave | Generate several prose contin

uations at the cursor, preview them, choose one, and retain its siblings. |
| Explore tokens | Inspe
ct captured token probabilities and alternatives, explore a bounded token tree, and continue from a

selected token. Requires model support. |
| Curate and export | Track Weave choices with a curation

meter. Export a path, its siblings, or kept prose as HTML, text, or JSON. |
| Delegate exploration |
Let the model expand, wait for, read, keep, and archive branches under branch, depth, token, and op

tional dollar budgets. |
| Find and navigate branches | Browse families in Multiverse, search own or
inherited messages, use tree keyboard shortcuts, and switch branches on mobile. |
## Install and set up
The Loom v0.1.0-alpha.1 source prerelease includes the matching Harness changes. It provides source,
with no npm package or installer for this fork. The published `@deepseek-ai/dsh` package does not i
nclude these Loom APIs; use the complete checkout below. Loom is experimental. Read the safety notic
e before running agents on your files.
### Run from source
Install Git 2.26+, Node.js 24+ (or Node 22.19 or later within 22.x), and pnpm **11.28.5**. The follo
wing commands use a POSIX shell; see the development guide for toolchain and Windows setup.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Open the URL printed by the launcher, including its local authentication token. This setup stores Lo
om's profiles, credentials, and Sessions in a separate, Git-ignored home and uses port **3097**, lea
ving the normal `~/.dsh` home and port **3080** untouched. To resume later, return to this checkout,
set the same `DSH_HOME`, and rerun the last command. Choose another unused port if 3097 is occupied
set the same `DSH_HOME`, and rerun the last command. Choose another unused port if 3097 is occupied.
### Configure your first Session
1. Open **Plugins**, select **More** beside **Experimental plugins**, and confirm **Loom** is enable

d. The install command above enables it; the switch also lets you turn it off.
2. Open **Settings →
Models**, enter your DeepSeek API key, and save. For OpenRouter, another provider, or a custom endpo

int, follow Configure models. Select a model in the composer.
3. Click **Choose workspace**, add a p

roject directory, and select it. Use a disposable project for your first experiment.
4. Start a conv
ersation. After its first completed turn, open **Loom** beside Chat; **Read**, **Compare**, and **We
ave** are available there. **Multiverse** appears in the sidebar.
Loom's Chat features use your configured model. Weave needs tool-free assistant-prefix support, and
probability exploration additionally needs token probabilities; the Loom guide explains these capabi
lities and the complete workflow.
### Make your first branches
Send this in Chat:
> Propose one small command-line task queue design. Keep it to five bullets and do not modify files.
Open the arrow beside **Regenerate**, select **×2**, and press **Regenerate ×2**. Open **Loom → Read
**, move between them, and mark a favorite **Keep**. Use **Branch several** to compare different ste
ering instructions or **Edit and branch** to revise the original prompt.
For competing code edits, select **Isolate each branch in a worktree** before branching, then use **
Compare** to inspect results. The workspace must be a Git repository with at least one commit, and t
he Session must allow workspace writes. Try **Weave** with a short story opening to explore prose in
sion must allow workspace writes. Try **Weave** with a short story opening to explore prose instead.
## Costs and limits
Each branch, prose continuation, and token probe can make additional paid model calls. No prices shi
p by default: without configured prices, Loom shows tokens; configured dollar figures are **list-pri
ce estimates**, not your account bill. Set small counts and budgets while exploring.
[该节后续省略]
## Documentation and support

- Loom user guide — branching, Compare, Weave, exports, and limits.
- Loom bundle — local installati

on, removal, and profile configuration.
- Loom service and autoloom tools — pricing, permissions, an

d budget settings.
- Fork issues — Loom feedback and bug reports.
- Upstream documentation — general
Harness usage; Loom's fork-specific instructions live in this repository.
